overall: The AG found no violation: the Board's January 15, 2019 executive session minutes, provided in February 2021, contained sufficient detail. The earlier December 2020 response had wrongly sent open-session minutes.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board failed to maintain adequate minutes of a January 15, 2019 executive session, which provided no detail of the discussions when requested.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the minutes of the January 15, 2019, executive session meeting are sufficiently detailed and therefore the Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law.
